fusions.name: Scent Strike
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to a bite that deals 24 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Circling Wake
fusions.desc: Churns the water around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Gorge
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health at once to whoever in your party is worst off.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 25% of the damage you deal heals you for 8 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
